name: Android Subsystem & Companion Storage Cleaner
author: WinCare Core Team
description: Storage cleaner for Windows Subsystem for Android (WSA), ADB device staging logs, and connected emulator caches.

tools.title: Windows Subsystem for Android Cache
tools.summary: Cleans temporary app caches and diagnostic telemetry from %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\*WSA*\LocalCache.

tools.title: ADB Staging APKs & Crash Dumps
tools.summary: Scans and cleans obsolete APK packages, daemon logs, and emulator crash dumps from ~/.android and %TEMP%.
